name: freemarker-intellisense
description: Completion, navigation, validation, and formatting for Apache FreeMarker templates, across imported and included files.

scripts.test: node ./test/syntax.test.js && node ./test/builtins.test.js && node ./test/directives.test.js && node ./test/template-index.test.js && node ./test/validator.test.js && node ./test/formatter.test.js && node ./test/comments.test.js && node ./test/semantic-tokens.test.js && node ./test/extension.test.js

freemarker.templateRoots.description: Additional workspace-relative directories searched when resolving template paths.

enumDescriptions: The first FreeMarker tag of a template decides.
freemarker.tagSyntax.description: The tag syntax of the templates, matching the tag_syntax setting of FreeMarker. A template that starts with <#ftl> or [#ftl] always uses the syntax of that tag.

freemarker.interpolationSyntax.description: The interpolation syntax of the templates, matching the interpolation_syntax setting of FreeMarker.

freemarker.validateTemplatePaths.description: Warn about import and include paths that cannot be found in the workspace or the configured template roots. Turn this off if templates are loaded from outside the workspace, for example from a JAR.

freemarker.validateHtmlTags.description: Warn about HTML tags that are never closed and about closing HTML tags without a start tag. Turn this off if the templates produce something other than HTML.

freemarker.validateUndeclaredNames.description: Warn about names that are declared neither in the template nor in the templates it includes or imports. Turn this off if the templates use many names from the data model.

freemarker.privatePrefix.description: Prefix used for private template definitions and namespace aliases. Private names are not exposed through imported namespaces.

semanticTokenModifiers.description: A variable that only exists inside a macro, a function, or a loop.
